user.title: Drexel und Weiss Aerosmart
user.description: Connects to the Aerosmart remote maintenance module (Fernwartungsmodul). Enter the address you use to open the module's web interface in a browser.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname, e.g. 192.168.1.50. The web interface address (http://192.168.1.50/home) works too.
data_description.scan_interval: How often values, faults and messages are read (10–3600 s).

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: The module always serves its data on port 334 under /dw; its web interface uses exactly these values. Only change them if the module is reached through port forwarding or a reverse proxy.

data_description.port: Port of the data interface (not the web interface port). Default: 334.
data_description.path: Path of the data interface, e.g. /dw → http://host:334/dw?area=values. Default: /dw.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from the module. Check the address and whether http://<host>:334/dw?area=values returns data in a browser.

data_description.scan_interval: How often values, faults and messages are read (10–3600 s).
